name: 4-nitrobenzoyl-CoA to H2O
summary: A 4-step route from 4-nitrobenzoyl-CoA(4−) to H2O, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: aureothin polyketide synthase system
reactions.equation: 4-nitrobenzoyl-CoA + 4 (S)-methylmalonyl-CoA + malonyl-CoA + 4 NADPH + 8 H(+) = demethylluteothin + 5 CO2 + 4 NADP(+) + 6 CoA + 3 H2O

reactions.name: luteothin monooxygenase
reactions.equation: luteothin + 4 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 2 O2 + 4 H(+) = aureothin + 4 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 3 H2O
